title: Insulated pipe: critical insulation radius (axisymmetric, analytic)
description:
Axisymmetric (r, z) steady conduction through a cylindrical insulation shell a < r < b around a pipe held at T_i (fixed_temperature_domain r < a), cooled by convection h to T_inf on its outer surface (x_hi = r = b); the y (z) faces are insulated, so the problem is radial. The sweep runs the outer radius b (the domain size) over 7.5-60 mm.
Analytic: heat loss per m of pipe q'(b) = 2 pi (T_i - T_inf) / (ln(b / a) / k + 1 / (h b)), largest at the critical radius b = k / h = 20 mm (thin insulation on a small pipe increases the loss); T(r) = T_i - q' ln(r / a) / (2 pi k).
Derived values tab: q_line (ring-weighted integral of the heat_flux_abs magnitude over the window / ((b - a) H) = q', checks the 2 pi r weighting; held cells read 0) and theta_surface (probe in the outermost cell, r = b - dx/2, rise over T_inf). Expect < 1e-3 (trapezoid rule of the cell-face conductances for ln(b / a), cell-centre averaging of the face fluxes).
Sweep tab: q_line vs b with the dashed q'(b), maximum at b = 20 mm.
Line profile tab (b = 60 mm): T_radial (log profile from r = a to b).

parameters.name: k_ins
parameters.description: insulation thermal conductivity in W/(m K)

parameters.name: h_conv
parameters.description: outer heat transfer coefficient in W/(m^2 K) (still air)

parameters.name: b_outer
parameters.description: outer insulation radius = domain size along r (swept)

parameters.name: H_slab
parameters.description: axial (z) height of the modelled slice, insulated faces

parameters.name: r_probe
parameters.description: probe radius: centre of the outermost cell

parameters.name: q_ref
parameters.description: analytic heat loss per m of pipe in W/m
